implementation_remediation.before: Calendar reads could manufacture COMPLETED revisions from the compatibility market_calendar table after a wall-clock cutoff; trading windows also used that legacy table.
implementation_remediation.after: MarketCalendarRepository reads only terminal md_market_calendar_revisions, resolves as-known successors, validates locked IDX/REGULAR/Asia-Jakarta scope and reconciliation metadata, rejects conflicts, and never writes on read. A VERIFIED label without source/reconciliation evidence cannot enter a trading window.

implementation_remediation.before: Any VERIFIED status row could establish expectation without stable instrument/board binding, a governed type, registered authority class/priority, immutable accepted source observation, full-session proof, or operator authority context.
implementation_remediation.after: TemporalTradingStatusRepository binds stable listing/instrument and the temporal board valid on T, governed status type and carry semantics, source registry authority/priority, accepted observation hash, exchange origin, operator triple, supersession, and as-known cutoff. Derived, incomplete, conflicting, ambiguous, or unsupported evidence yields explicit UNKNOWN.

implementation_remediation.before: No single explainable service combined completed calendar, temporal listing and status facts; eligibility and event-risk paths could reduce expectation through legacy projections or incomplete status context.
implementation_remediation.after: ExpectedBarDecisionService emits EXPECTED/NOT_EXPECTED/UNKNOWN with calendar revision, source/version, status revision/evidence and reason. Eligibility, event-risk and acquisition boundaries consume the governed decision; half days remain normal sessions and provider absence/dormancy/volume cannot establish NOT_EXPECTED.

implementation_remediation.before: Trading-status transport did not require declared origin/reference/hash and canonical status revisions lacked the stable/source/operator metadata required by current authority.
implementation_remediation.after: The additive hardening migration adds immutable authority metadata and a governed source registry; authoritative snapshot capture binds source observations and stable IDs; import is TRANSPORT_ONLY and requires origin/reference/hash plus the operator triple when applicable. Unsupported legacy calendar claims receive appended PROJECTED/UNKNOWN successors rather than historical edits.

implementation_remediation.before: MarketDataPriceReadRepository and PriceScaleBreakDetectionService still read market_calendar directly; multiple current test/runtime fixtures encoded the obsolete contract.
implementation_remediation.after: Every application read routes through MarketCalendarRepository. Current fixtures issue canonical verified revision facts with complete reconciliation metadata; a targeted search finds no DB::table('market_calendar') execution in app, tests/Unit/MarketData or tests/Support.
